event.location_text: MALACCA STRAIT Dumai Anchorage, Indonesia Indonesia 01° 43.29' N 101° 25.72' E

sources.title: Piracy monthly report January 2024
sources.text: Duty security patrol onboard an anchored tanker noticed five unauthorised persons attempting to board and immediately notified the OOW. Alarm raised, resulting in the persons aborting and moving away. Nothing reported stolen. The incident was reported to the port control and the pilot station.
